create_interrupt_resolution: create an InterruptResolution component with player names and custom event tag for action resolution
run_interrupt_resolution_pre_act: run the pre_act method to resolve entity actions from putative events into scheduler mutations
get_active_entity_name: get the name of the last entity whose action was resolved by InterruptResolution
get_putative_action: get the last putative action text extracted during the most recent resolution step
save_and_restore_interrupt_resolution_st: save and restore InterruptResolution state via get_state and set_state for serialization
